subject: Orion Analytics — schedule ML infra lab (60-90m) & roster alignment
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@orionanalytics.com>, DevOps Team <devops-team@orionanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orion Analytics — schedule ML infra lab (60-90m) & roster alignment

Hi Samantha — great run through today, thanks for walking us through your inference goals and the latency/cost constraints. Quick recap and recommended next step: a 60–90 minute ML infra lab with our engineering leads to run through architecture, data paths, and a short perf/cost sketch.

What we need from you to lock the session:
- Preferred time zone and 2–3 slot options within the next 10 business days
- Attendee roster (identify the engineer who owns the model infra + the security/compliance contact)
- Any hard requirements (blocked IP ranges, VPC needs, compliance docs to review beforehand)

Proposed agenda (draft, will iterate):
1) 5m intro & success criteria
2) 20m architecture review (your infra + models)
3) 30m live discussion: routing, caching, latency SLOs, and quantization tradeoffs
4) 20–30m ops: deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private), security/QoS
5) 5–10m action items & mutual action plan

I've looped in Ben (solutions) and Marcus (inference infra) — they’ll lead the deep dive. If useful, we can share a short preread (security checklist + agenda) and a shared doc to capture M.A.P.

Next steps: send 2–3 slots and attendee names and I’ll circulate a calendar invite + preread.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
